noteHtml:
For this project we can use ResNet18 because it is relatively lightweight and works well for transfer learning.

In fastai, the model is usually backed by PyTorch.

resnet18.title: ResNet18
resnet18.text:
An 18-layer residual convolutional neural network architecture.

Uses residual/skip connections.

Implemented in frameworks such as [[PyTorch]].

pytorch.title: PyTorch
pytorch.text:
A Python framework for building and training neural networks.

You can write anything you want in this card.
